title: PlayerSmp
description: Let players make their own SMP in your server.
body:
# PlayerSMP | Player created SMP  
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cb207816a91f0bc88d20e8f991ff63b1bd419e7.png)
Let your server players make their own smp.
## Table of content
- Why PlayerSMP?
- Installation
- Commands
- Config
## Why PlayerSMP
In PlayerSMP you can let players have their own SMP. Limit how many SMPs a player can create.
Limit the World size. Player can change gamemodes. Toggle pvp on/off.
## Installation
```
1. Download the latest PlayerSMP release jar.
2. Download the latest Multivese-core jar.
3. Drop it into your server's plugins/ folder.
4. Restart the server and you are ready to go!
```
## In-SMP Commands 
- `/psgm creative/survival <PLAYERS NAME>- ` Sets players to creative or survival
## Commands
- `/smp create/delete <WORLD NAME> - ` Creates and deletes the smp world
- `/smp join <WORLD NAME> or <PLAYER NAME> - ` Joining a SMP
- `/smp leave - ` Leaving an SMP
- `/smp invite/uninvite - ` Invites and uninvites players to a private smp 
- `/smp open/close - ` Open and close a SMP to public 
- `/smp info - ` Information about the SMP

## Config
![DEFAULT CONFIG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31768c4a8dbd808a9c13e80a3ce0e180baac083e.png)

- max-worlds-per-player - Limits how many worlds a player can make
- max-worlds-total - Limits how many worlds a server can have

- worlds-root SMPWORLDS - Saves SMPs world in this folder
- use-symlinks - Links the SMPWORLDS folder to servers root

- default-pvp - Pvp enabled in default

- world-border-enabled - Enables Borders to the world
- world-border-diameter - How many blocks in diameter long    
- world-border-warning - Warns player when they are near the border. per block
